journal: Journal of Industrial and Engineering Chemistry 34, 117-121
experimental_method: Methane bubbled at 3 L/min through stirred salt solution at 30 C and ambient pressure in a bubble column; samples taken over time, heated to 95 C in sealed vials to expel methane, headspace analysed by GC-FID; plateau value is the 'maximum solubility'.
uncertainties_stated: Each measurement performed at least three times; error bars only in Fig. 3, no numerical uncertainty.
quality_remarks: Only 'ambient pressure' given (CH4 partial pressure with water vapour not stated, nor wt/wt vs wt/vol). Pure-water value 21.7 mg/L at 30 C is a plateau from kinetic curve. Table 3 expt column repeats Table 2.
